name: Hitozuma♪ Kasumi-san ~Oyako to Kyoudou Seikatsu~
original_name: 人妻♪かすみさん～母娘と共同性活～
source:
Ryouji Matsubara, a college student attending a university in a certain regional city, currently lives alone in an apartment.
His uncle—his father’s younger brother—and his family live nearby, and toward the end of the month when money gets tight, he often goes over for meals or helps his cousin Mio with her studies, maintaining a relatively close relationship with his relatives.
Since his uncle was constantly busy traveling all over the country, Ryouji had become a reliable presence for his cousin Mio and his uncle’s wife, Kasumi. One day, Ryouji received a call from Kasumi on his cell phone. Her voice was trembling on the other end of the line, and when he asked what had happened, it turned out their home had apparently been burglarized.
After that incident, Ryouji’s uncle, Toshishi, suggested that he move out of his apartment and come live with them.
Ryouji hesitated at first, but after strong encouragement from Kasumi and Mio, he decided to move in with his uncle’s family.
Ryouji, who harbored a faint crush on Kasumi, found himself unconsciously letting his imagination run wild.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/kasumi/cg/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
就读于某地方都市大学的大学生松原良治，目前独自租住在公寓里。
他的叔父——也就是父亲的弟弟——一家人就住在附近；每逢月底手头拮据时，良治常去叔父家蹭饭，或是帮堂妹未央辅导功课，与亲戚一家走动得颇为亲近。
由于叔父工作繁忙、常年奔波于全国各地出差，良治渐渐成了堂妹未央与婶婶霞信赖依靠的主心骨。某天，良治的手机突然接到了婶婶霞打来的电话；电话那头她的声音瑟瑟发抖，追问之下才得知，叔父家似乎遭了入室盗窃。
这起事件过后，叔父寿志主动提议让良治退掉外面的公寓，搬来家里一同居住。
良治起初还有些犹豫，但在婶婶霞与堂妹未央的热情挽留下，最终还是决定搬进叔父家中。
原本就对美貌的婶婶霞怀着一丝朦胧好感的良治，思绪不由自主地开始想入非非。
